scientific_integrity: Analytical coupling and equality proof supplied; computational checks are independent finite rational comparisons only. No independent review or historical-priority guarantee is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real Lipschitz inputs, univariate classical Bernstein operators, neighboring positive integer degrees; no exact results for non-neighboring degrees, other kernel families or other Hölder exponents. title: Sharp successive-degree Bernstein stability and the rigid interlacing extremizer
